faq.q1: How does a consultation with the Master work?
faq.a1: You choose one of the readings, pay securely and receive your analysis within 24 hours. Through the chat terminal, you can also ask me your questions directly.
faq.q2: What details do I need to send?
faq.a2: Full name, date, time and place of birth. The more precise the chart, the deeper the reading.
faq.a3: Credit card, debit card and Pix, with 100% secure payment processed by Stripe.
faq.q4: How long until I receive my analysis?
faq.a4: The Lightning Reading answers within 24 hours. The Complete Natal Chart takes up to 3 business days. The Monthly Guide follows you through the whole lunar cycle.
faq.a5: Write to contato@mestreagnes.com within 7 days of purchase. Every case is reviewed with care and attention.

horoscope.essence.aries: Your fire energy calls for movement: today, acting is worth more than waiting.
horoscope.essence.taurus: Your steady nature seeks security; what is solid grows slowly and endures.
horoscope.essence.gemini: Your curious mind connects ideas fast; the right word opens doors today.
horoscope.essence.cancer: Your sensitivity notices what was never said; caring is also your strength.
horoscope.essence.leo: Your natural glow draws attention; today the stage is yours, use it generously.
horoscope.essence.virgo: Your watchful eye catches details others miss; precision is your gift.
horoscope.essence.libra: You seek balance and harmony; today, choosing is also a way of caring for yourself.
horoscope.essence.scorpio: Your intensity transforms everything it touches; trust what you feel.
horoscope.essence.sagittarius: Your adventurous soul needs a horizon; expanding is your nature.
horoscope.essence.capricorn: Your discipline builds what lasts; today's effort is tomorrow's foundation.
horoscope.essence.aquarius: Your original mind sees the future before others; your difference is your value.
horoscope.essence.pisces: Your deep intuition senses the invisible; trust your dreams and your art.

horoscope.tone.2: An unexpected conversation may change the course of your week.
horoscope.tone.3: Mercury brings mental clarity: a great moment to decide and organize.
horoscope.tone.4: The stars signal harvest: acknowledge how much you have already built.

zodiacStory.aries: The golden-horned ram comes from the myth of the golden fleece; the constellation of Aries once marked the spring equinox.
zodiacStory.taurus: The white bull is Zeus in disguise in the myth of Europa; the constellation of Taurus holds Aldebaran and the Pleiades.
zodiacStory.gemini: The twins are Castor and Pollux, inseparable brothers of Greek myth; the constellation bears the name of both stars.
zodiacStory.cancer: The crab comes from Karkinos, sent by Hera against Heracles; the constellation of Cancer holds the Beehive cluster.
zodiacStory.leo: The lion is the one of Nemea, defeated by Heracles; the constellation of Leo holds Regulus, the lion's heart.
zodiacStory.virgo: The maiden is Astraea, the goddess of justice who left the Earth; the constellation of Virgo holds the star Spica, the ear of wheat.
zodiacStory.libra: The scales are the instrument Astraea uses to weigh destinies; it is the only zodiac sign shown as an object.
zodiacStory.scorpio: The scorpion wounded Orion in the myth; the constellation of Scorpio holds Antares, the red heart.
zodiacStory.sagittarius: The centaur archer aims his arrow at the heart of the Scorpion; the constellation holds the centre of the Milky Way.
zodiacStory.capricorn: The goat-fish is Amalthea, who nursed Zeus; the constellation lies toward the centre of the galaxy.
zodiacStory.aquarius: The water bearer is Ganymede, cupbearer of the gods; Aquarius lies in the sky's water constellation region.
zodiacStory.pisces: The two fish are Aphrodite and Eros, who transformed to escape Typhon; the constellation is tied to the vernal point.
chineseStory.rato: In the legend the Rat crossed the river on the Ox's back and leapt ahead at the finish — that is why it opens the cycle.
chineseStory.boi: The Ox carried the Rat across the river with patience; its quiet strength stands for work and trust.
chineseStory.tigre: The Tiger is king of the mountains and arrived third, a symbol of courage before the unknown.
chineseStory.coelho: The Rabbit leapt from stone to stone and took fourth place, a symbol of grace and prudence.
chineseStory.dragao: The Dragon stopped to bring rain to the villages and arrived after the Rabbit — power in the service of good.
chineseStory.serpente: The Snake coiled around the Dragon's leg and came sixth, a symbol of wisdom and strategy.
chineseStory.cavalo: The Horse is the seventh animal, a free spirit that crosses the plains in motion.
chineseStory.cabra: The Goat arrived eighth, sharing the path with the Monkey — kindness and cooperation.
chineseStory.macaco: The Monkey is ninth, a clever bridge-builder, a symbol of intelligence and wit.
chineseStory.galo: The Rooster is tenth, the bird that announces dawn with punctuality and discipline.
chineseStory.cao: The Dog is eleventh, the faithful guardian who protects the home and those we love.
chineseStory.porco: The Pig closed the cycle in twelfth place, a symbol of generosity and abundance.
